notes:
Patch 0.1.20

Performance
- Fixed a stuck height-stitch remesh that rebuilt the same streaming terrain tiles every frame (Split world ~195 ms / ~5 FPS). Each tile remeshes once, then the pass stops.

Desktop shortcut
- In-game “Add shortcut” now creates Desktop\Manafall.lnk through PowerShell (same approach as the patcher). COM-only create was unreliable.
- Create-Desktop-Shortcut.cmd / .ps1 next to Manafall.exe handle Desktop and OneDrive Desktop paths more carefully.
- If a shortcut was created before and later deleted, the menu can offer again. A one-time “Not now” still stays quiet.

Clients / inventory
- Pure clients now see wood, stone, and other server grants on the hotbar/inventory (server notifies the owner after pickup).

Combat / HUD
- Hurt blood overlay is local-only again. Remote players no longer leave the shared blood frame stuck after you respawn.
- Heat-stroke collapse can kill even when the health bar is not empty yet.
- Thirst / hunger DoT no longer spams the hurt sound every tick.

Spawn
- First wilderness spawn stays on dry land above the sea, clears landmarks by ~200 m, and reuses a pose warmed under the loading screen so you are less likely to appear underground.

Multiplayer safety
- Server anti-cheat strike ledger: movement speed / teleport watch, debug command refusal in player builds, jail teleports grant a short movement grace.
- Player chat HUD (proximity / global / group) ships with the client.

Also includes the 0.1.19 menu hang fixes if you are still on an older install — prefer Apply from Online, or Mega Download for a full reinstall.
